payload.name: Reverse foot-in-the-door effect
payload.fact: Low-preference-for-consistency individuals can demonstrate a reverse foot-in-the-door effect when their prior helpfulness is made salient.
payload.boundary: This effect occurs in individuals with low preference for consistency (PFC) under specific salience conditions.
